buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract

quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must have experience in carrying out the above-mentioned work in a Local Body. A verified p hotocopy of the Experience Certificate/Work Order must be submitted. 2. The bidder/service provider institution must submit a Character Certificate issued by the concerned Dist rict Magistrate. The certificate must have been issued before the last date of bid submission and must be v alid. 3. Along with the GeM Tender, an FDR/EMD of ₹75000/- must be deposited. Submission of the EMD is comp ulsory for all bidders, with no exemption for MSMEs/Startups. 4. After acceptance of the tender, the successful bidder must submit an affidavit on ₹100/- non-judicial sta mp paper, duly verified by a Public Notary. The prescribed format may be obtained from the concerned offi ce. 5. The service provider must possess Experience Certificates, GeM Portal Work Orders, and Selection/Acce ptance Orders. These documents shall also be displayed at the work site. 6. The Buyer shall verify all documents submitted by the bidder. If any document is found to be forged, fal se, misleading, or otherwise invalid, the bid shall be liable for rejection and the bidder may be blacklisted a nd/or subject to legal action. A notarized affidavit to this effect shall be uploaded by the bidder. 7. If the L1 bidder selected through the GeM Portal fails to submit a valid Experience Certificate for similar work to the concerned office within the stipulated 48 hours, the bid of the L1 bidder shall be declared inelig ible. 8. Any query or objection may be submitted only within the prescribed bid date and time period. Any comp laint or objection received after closure of the bid or at the time of bid opening shall not be considered. 9. The bidder/service provider institution must have prior experience of at least 03 (three) similar works. A s proof of such experience, a GeM Work Order for each work must be submitted. 10. No tender shall be considered without the required Security/Earnest Money Deposit. 11. If, for any reason, payment is not made to the bidder by the Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, th e bidder shall bear the financial responsibility for payment related to the work. 12. Statutory deductions shall be made from the bill payment as per applicable rules, and the bidder shall accept such deductions. 13. All bid documents, along with the EMD of ₹75000/- submitted/uploaded while participating in the bid, must also be physically submitted to the Buyer’s office within 5 days from the Bid End Date/Bid Opening D ate. Failure to submit the required documents and EMD within the stipulated time may result in rejection o f the bid. 14. The bidder is required to submit the PAN Card, GST Certificate along with the Current GST Return, Aad haar Card, and other required documents along with the bid. 15. Any Gazetted Officer who is/was working in an administrative department of the State Government or Central Government shall be prohibited from undertaking contractual work for a period of two years after r etirement without prior permission of the Government. If it is found that the contractor or his/her represent ative has not obtained the required prior permission from the State Government before submitting the bid, or has started working with the bidder without such permission, the contract may be cancelled. 16. In the event of any untoward incident involving any vehicle driver/employee during execution of the w ork, the entire responsibility shall lie with the service provider. 17. If the service provider fails to pay employees on time or fails to deposit employees’ Provident Fund as per applicable rules, or if vehicle drivers/employees go on strike or stage any protest, the service provider

shall be solely responsible. 18. A declaration regarding the benefit/profit under each applicable scheme shall be submitted along with the bid documents. 19. The firm’s registered GSTN and office must be located within the State of Uttar Pradesh. 20. Experience in the same category shall be given preference. 21. If the performance of the executing agency remains satisfactory, the agency may be considered for the work again in the future. 22. Conditional tenders shall not be considered. 23. The Chairman, Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, shall have the right to accept or reject any ten der without assigning any reason. 24. The bidder/service provider must possess a valid Labour Certificate issued/registered in Uttar Pradesh, wherever applicable. 25. Any bidder shall not be eligible to participate in the bidding process if the bidder himself/herself or any of his/her close relatives, including first blood relations or spouse, is employed in any capacity in the Nagar Palika Parishad, Nagar Panchayat, or Forest Corporation, Uttar Pradesh. The bidder shall upload a notarize d affidavit in this regard. 26. The bidder shall upload a notarized affidavit declaring that he/she has not been blacklisted by any Gov ernment Department, has no criminal record, neither the bidder nor any of its partners/directors is enrolled with any Bar Council, and that the bidder maintains good reputation and conduct with Governmen t Departments as on the Bid Effective Date. 27. The bidder shall upload a declaration on ₹100/- non-judicial stamp paper, duly notarized, certifying the correctness and authenticity of all information, declarations, and documents submitted with the bid. The bi dder shall also submit the original hard copy of the declaration to the Buyer within 5 days from the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date. 28. The supply of all items/materials related to the bid shall be completed on or before 15-11-2026 from th e date of issuance of the Work Order. 29. The bidder shall confirm acceptance of all terms and conditions of the bid. Such confirmation shall be u ploaded on the bidder’s letterhead, and the bidder shall submit the hard copy to the Buyer within 5 days fr om the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date. 30. If the bidder fails to upload any required document, or uploads an unreadable, incomplete, or unclear scanned copy, the bidder shall be disqualified. . 3.
